legal.termsBody: The complete Terms of Service for UPNEX are provided below. By using UPNEX you agree to use the platform for lawful academic and career purposes, keep your account credentials private, and provide truthful information about your education, marks and projects. UPNEX verifies documents you upload but does not confirm achievements you enter manually. Uploaded documents remain owned by you. UPNEX may suspend accounts that misuse the platform. The full text of these terms remains available in English for legal precision.
legal.privacyBody: UPNEX stores the personal information you provide (name, email, academic records, uploaded certificates and public profile details) to operate your student profile. Your documents and OCR data are private by default and are never shared without your explicit choice to publish. We use cookies to keep you signed in and analytics to improve the product. You may request deletion of your data at any time. We do not sell your data. The full text of this policy remains available in English for legal precision.
